description: NaNO₃ is Calcite-like structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.79 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.52 Å. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and two longer (1.27 Å) N-O bond lengths.
